completion_criteria.text: 0092 diagnosis: the merge-boundary preflight never exits non-zero with empty stdout again - every non-zero exit emits a human-readable reason, and running the CLI directly with no MITOSIS_BOUNDARY_* env prints why it refused. Proven by executing the real CLI in that exact unconfigured state and reading its output.

0092 posture: a decision record settles whether the unconfigured boundary halts the run or degrades with a surfaced warning, and the engine implements what that record decides. The record must state the security trade-off explicitly, since fail-closed is what currently makes the engine unusable.

0092 receipt: a test execs the real preflight CLI end-to-end instead of stubbing the verdict, and it is RED when the step-7 call site is severed and GREEN when it is wired. The red state is demonstrated by actually severing the call site in a scratch copy, not asserted.

0093: gate identity stops being string equality on an unresolved path - the gate resolves a real path, or is relocated outside the repo it manages. A test redirects the path to a different file and asserts the gate refuses rather than trusting it.

0094: the config guard covers git worktrees - a write to a guarded path inside a real git worktree of this repo is held for human confirmation, asserted by a test that builds an actual worktree fixture rather than simulating one.

Each of the above lands as its own MSP through the centralized pr-create tool, and origin/main is verified fully green (full suite, exit 0) after each merge - re-derived from the remote, never from a possibly-stale local main.

spine.active_goal: Two tracks. (1) 0099: the merge boundary becomes ONE honest gate - layer 2 deleted, layer 1 reshaped to gate only on no-direct-push-to-base plus active repo-owned ruleset binding, identity/admin/review demoted and relabelled. Posture CLOSED. (2) 0100/0101: pin the global install to a detached origin/main worktree at ~/.claude-install, landing the safeguards BEFORE the pin so staleness can never be silent.
spine.next_step: Per 0101, in order: (1) relocate .drift-state.json to ~/.claude/state/ and untrack (superpowers-drift-check.sh:4 writes it; fix its :7 fail-open too). (2) SessionStart freshness check - auto-refresh when behind AND clean, loud when dirty or offline, NEVER exit 0 quietly. (3) Install-root hard DENY plus chmod -R a-w. (4) Re-author the migration script (old one ephemeral; keep mv -fh) and apply. THEN MSP B, then MSP C. MSP A done and verified but UNPUSHED, no PR.
open_risks: R4 is DECIDED (0100) but UNAPPLIED. Until the pin lands, ~/.claude still serves the primary checkout on feat/centralized-pr-creation, so the merge-boundary gate stays absent from the live install and MSP B/C remain inert - they edit code that is not there.

PREREQUISITE blocking the pin: superpowers-drift-check.sh:4 writes .drift-state.json, a TRACKED file. Post-migration it permanently dirties the install worktree and destroys the cleanliness signal. Relocate to ~/.claude/state/ and untrack FIRST.

The migration script sits at an EPHEMERAL scratchpad path and will not survive. Re-author from 0100/0101. PRESERVE the mv -fh fix: BSD mv -f FOLLOWS a symlink resolving to a directory, so lib and rules/common would survive untouched while stray temp symlinks land inside them.

RULESET EXISTS - supersedes 'assume it does not exist'. id 19939922, active, repo-owned, binds ~DEFAULT_BRANCH, 0 approvals, empty bypass, bypass=never. Layer 1's ruleset invariant (:262) is now SATISFIED; identity (:153), admin===false (:171), review>=1 (:236-241) stay unsatisfiable.

0099 ACCEPTED CONSEQUENCE: with zero approvals no server-side mechanism distinguishes an agent merging a PR from a human. Direct push to main IS blocked server-side (bypass never), but MERGE stays gated only by client-side denies. Never call it a human-gated merge.

MSP A residual: its fail-closed branch matches only the four prefixes, not the four exact filenames, so <worktree>/.claude/settings.json escapes that branch. The normal path still covers it; widening is free since the decision is ask, not deny.

SAME FAIL-OPEN CLASS, THIRD INSTANCE, unfixed: superpowers-drift-check.sh:7 opens with [ -f "$RESOLVER" ] || exit 0, so the drift checker silently reports nothing when its dependency is missing. Step 1 touches this exact file - fix it there.
~/.zshrc still symlinks into the PRIMARY checkout, so shell config keeps tracking whatever branch is out. Same coupling class as R4, outside R4's scope, UNDECIDED.

The gh merge-deny shim is NOT on PATH (command -v gh gives /opt/homebrew/bin/gh); its classifier only guards mitosis-git.mjs's own execGh calls. settings.json:40 is a PREFIX pattern that push origin HEAD:main would not match - read, never tested.

PROCESS, reaffirmed: subagent self-reports are NOT trustworthy. This session re-ran MSP A's full hook suite and all four live probes directly rather than believing the report, and caught its own broken sed before reporting a false 404 as evidence.
